intent.why: verify-gate.sh already discovers .orca/dispatch-pubkey and passes --dispatch-pubkey, so committing the key is one switch for two enforcements; the doc and the dormancy pin now say so, so the maintainer flips it consciously. Reading the key at the pin keeps history consistent for pins ON the grading base's ancestry (pre-key reports keep today's path); round 1's review refuted the claim that artifacts-at-rev blocked dodging — a fork from a pre-key commit carries fresh artifacts and no key — so an OFF-ancestry pin is now judged against the key at the grading base (G-1).
